items.title: Operator System Card
items.summary: Drawing from OpenAI’s established safety frameworks, this document highlights our multi-layered approach, including model and product mitigations we’ve implemented to protect against prompt engineering and jailbreaks, protect privacy and security, as well as details our external red teaming efforts, safety evaluations, and ongoing work to further refine these safeguards.
